{{Top|leg}}
'''Osma bags''' were small [[Leather/Legends|leather]] pouches filled with a collection of trinkets and a small pinch of [[Socorran]] sand. [[Ibhaan'I]] [[Shaman/Legends|shamans]] put osma bags together as a form of blessing. After talking to the recipient, the shaman would select items already in their possession or undertake a journey of several [[Standard day/Legends|days]] to gather them. The chosen items would have a meaning to the receiver and reveal the life-destiny path of the recipient.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
